title: Art Fight 2026
description: My art contributions to the 2026 Art Fight event

images.imgCaption: A cool deity character to set the mood right as my first attack!
images.imgAlt: Orange draconic anthro character on a simple purple background with white and grey skull, orange tendrils for hair with yellow bands and green straps around them. His arms are outstretched and there are gold + orange lines emanating from his figure.

images.imgCaption: I haaaaad to draw a huge beefy scalie to start art fight out right!
images.imgAlt: Large, muscular, brown and blue anthro T-rex wearing short pink shorts. He's flexing with both arms upraised, showing chest and abdominal musculature with a slight smirk towards the viewer, standing in front of a simple reddish purple background

images.imgCaption: Found a cool cobra with great colors! This was a fun experiment in line weights and shading.
images.imgAlt: Gradient-colored anthro cobra character with scales and hood colored pinks, purples, and blues over a somewhat-camo basic blue background. The cobra is looking to the left, long neck craned over, perched against his fist. His tail is curling up behind him a bit

images.imgCaption: I knew I wanted to draw my two friends' protogens...and then I came up with a stupid goofy idea >:3
images.imgAlt: A yellow and purple protogen with arm upraised, looking for someone--implied to be Kiln, another lava/liquid glass protogen who has become somehow trapped inside Lumie's lava lamp plates

images.imgCaption: My friend Briva has this adorable funky worm on a string character and I just felt like I had to hold her...
images.imgAlt: A fuzzy green anthro worm on a string character, bashfully sitting in the palm of a yellow and pink hand, holding its tail. The background is a vague foresty background with some shelf fungus and leaves floating in the background

images.imgCaption: Translating a friend's gorgeous comic style into my own within character design was such a challenge!
images.imgAlt: An anthro blue and orange velociraptor in swordsman clothes and leather armor. He has a tired expression, and is sighing as he holds a cup of hot tea. He sits at a bar or table in an implied tavern or bar.

images.imgCaption: One of my personal faves partially because I'm proud of how the Synth came out, but I love how I manually scrungled Fromage's board game box :3
images.imgAlt: A White and dark-blue synth with mint green accents holding the board game "Fromage" while swishing his tail behind himself. He's asking if you want to play the game, indicated with a little cheese icon next to a question mark.

images.imgCaption: I love drawing protogens so much and I wanna get better at it! This guy had a fun, simpler style that I felt I could experiment with.
images.imgAlt: Red and grey gaming-pad themed protogen giving a peace sign with his hand, smiling towards the left side of the screen. He's in front of a red background with a chromatic aberrated 8 pointed star

images.imgCaption: My annual art for my girlfriend--I love her goofy ribbon eel character, so I turned him into a little bean!
images.imgAlt: A goofy ribbon eel character, simplified so that he is pretty short with a kind of lumpy bean body and a goofy face. He's drifting in front of a vague kelp background`

images.imgCaption: Easily my magnum opus for this year. I spent a lot of time on the pose, and trying to push muscles a bit towards hyper but without going Too far. I think I succeeded!
images.imgAlt: Dark grey anthro male Komodo Dragon in front of a simple red geometric shape background. He's extremely muscular, wearing just shorts and a tattered headband. His hands are posed in an aggressive fighting pose and his single visible eye is directed towards the viewer with unknowable expression. The right side of his body is covered with black bands of tattoos that wrap around his arm, chest, and hands.

images.imgCaption: My first Kobold drawing in so many years...I wanted to draw for my friend who I always attack each year at least once. Proud of this pose!
images.imgAlt: A large pink and blueish Naga smiling and flexing a massive bicep while a yellow and green Kobold excitedly hangs/swings off of it, exclaiming in joy

images.imgCaption: Final art fight for this year. A revenge piece for my dear friend Juniper. I've never drawn a ram before! I could use some practice...she's pretty though :3
images.imgAlt: Left-facing profile of an anthropomorphic ram lady with tan skin and yellow fluffy wooly hair. She's smiling slightly, looking at the viewer with partially obscured light blue eye. The background is a simple green mint gradient with some texture.
